Movies.title: The Prestige
Movies.note: Rival magicians turn every performance into a strategic move. Watch how each man reacts to losing.

Movies.title: The Invisible Guest
Movies.note: A suspect briefs his lawyer against the clock. Every revision changes which explanation you can trust.

Movies.title: The Departed
Movies.note: Two moles hunt each other from opposite sides. The double pursuit scratches the Light-versus-L itch.

Movies.title: Edge of Tomorrow
Movies.note: A soldier repeats one disastrous battle. Each death buys information, so progress feels earned like a tough game.

Movies.title: The Dark Knight
Movies.note: Batman faces an opponent who plans around his moral code. The opening robbery sets the pace.

Movies.title: Memento
Movies.note: A man investigates using notes he left himself. Tracking what he can actually know is the puzzle.

Movies.title: Inception
Movies.note: A heist crew must coordinate across layers of dreams. The rules matter to the final operation.

Movies.title: Knives Out
Movies.note: A detective questions a wealthy family after a death. Suspect motives are entertaining from the first interviews.

Movies.title: Inside Man
Movies.note: A bank robber and a hostage negotiator trade moves. The question is what the robber really wants.

Movies.title: Source Code
Movies.note: Eight minutes aboard a train are all an investigator gets. Each replay eliminates a different theory.

Movies.title: Shutter Island
Movies.note: A missing patient brings two marshals to an isolated hospital. The investigation rewards close attention.

Movies.title: Se7en
Movies.note: Two detectives follow a killer's deliberate pattern. Particularly grim even by crime-thriller standards.

Movies.title: Minority Report
Movies.note: A detective who arrests future killers becomes a suspect. The chase puts the system's logic under pressure.

Movies.title: Drishyam
Movies.note: A family man anticipates a police investigation. Allow time for the domestic setup before the chess match.

Movies.title: Searching
Movies.note: A father searches his daughter's digital trail. Tiny details on screens become clues you can spot yourself.

Movies.title: The Game
Movies.note: A banker accepts an unusual birthday gift. The fun is testing where the game's rules end.

Movies.title: The Bourne Identity
Movies.note: An amnesiac pieces together his training while being hunted. His choices show his intelligence.

Movies.title: Prisoners
Movies.note: A disappearance pits a father's certainty against a detective's method. Tense but deliberately paced.

Movies.title: The Usual Suspects
Movies.note: An interrogation reconstructs a criminal operation. Pay attention to who controls the telling.

Movies.title: The Fugitive
Movies.note: A surgeon must investigate a murder while evading a marshal. Both sides make credible moves.

Movies.title: Mission: Impossible – Fallout
Movies.note: A failed exchange forces a team to improvise. Best after Rogue Nation for the character stakes.

Movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
Movies.note: A trusted institution becomes the mystery. A strong fit for your love of Avengers-era team dynamics.

Movies.title: The Matrix
Movies.note: A hacker suspects reality has hidden rules. Discovering them changes what the hero can do.

Movies.title: Predestination
Movies.note: A time agent pursues a bomber. The dialogue-heavy middle asks you to build a timeline.

Movies.title: Looper
Movies.note: An assassin's next target is his future self. Competing agendas make the time rules personal.

Movies.title: Coherence
Movies.note: A dinner party notices something wrong outside. Small continuity details do most of the storytelling.

Movies.title: The Terminator
Movies.note: A woman is hunted for something that hasn't happened yet. Lean pursuit with a clear objective.

Movies.title: Sicario
Movies.note: An FBI agent joins an opaque operation. Watch who receives information and who gives orders.

Movies.title: Heat
Movies.note: A detective and a thief study each other's routines. Long character scenes buy a strong confrontation.

Movies.title: Collateral
Movies.note: A cab driver must survive a night with a contract killer. A tight deadline keeps it moving.

Movies.title: Speed
Movies.note: Passengers must keep a bus above a speed threshold. The simple rule drives inventive problem-solving.

Movies.title: Train to Busan
Movies.note: A train becomes a sequence of survival problems. Alliances matter as much as the threat.

Movies.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
Movies.note: An archaeologist races rivals to an artefact. Clear objectives and physical puzzles suit your adventure-game taste.

Movies.title: The Raid
Movies.note: A police unit becomes trapped inside a tower. Floor-by-floor combat has the precision you liked in Sifu.

Movies.title: Upgrade
Movies.note: An implant gives an injured man unusual abilities. Control of the body becomes the central question.

Movies.title: Dredd
Movies.note: Two judges must fight their way out of a sealed tower. Short, brutal and objective-driven.

Movies.title: Nightcrawler
Movies.note: A freelance crime cameraman learns how to manipulate a market. The strategist is unsettling to follow.

Movies.title: Gone Girl
Movies.note: A disappearance plays out under public scrutiny. Perception becomes a tool in the investigation.

Movies.title: L.A. Confidential
Movies.note: Three detectives pursue overlapping cases. Their conflicting methods give the conspiracy texture.

Movies.title: The Negotiator
Movies.note: A framed negotiator takes hostages to buy time. The verbal duel is the draw.

Movies.title: Vikram Vedha
Movies.note: A gangster tests a cop with stories and choices. Moral deductions replace a straightforward chase.

Movies.title: Kahaani
Movies.note: A woman hunts for her missing husband in Kolkata. The city itself supplies clues and misdirection.

Movies.title: Andhadhun
Movies.note: A pianist witnesses something dangerous. Dark comedy keeps reshuffling who holds the advantage.

Movies.title: A Wednesday!
Movies.note: A caller forces officials into a timed negotiation. A compact contest of information and leverage.

Movies.title: Kaithi
Movies.note: A former prisoner must transport injured officers through the night. One mission ties the action together.

Movies.title: Vikram
Movies.note: An investigator follows a pattern of killings. Watch after Kaithi for the shared-world payoff.

Movies.title: The Batman
Movies.note: A masked killer leaves riddles for Batman. Strong Arkham atmosphere, with a long and moody runtime.

Movies.title: The Martian
Movies.note: A stranded astronaut solves one survival constraint at a time. Competence drives the suspense.

Movies.title: Dunkirk
Movies.note: An evacuation unfolds on three time scales. The puzzle is how the timelines converge.

Movies.title: The Hunt for Red October
Movies.note: Analysts must infer a submarine commander's intentions. Strategy carries more weight than explosions.

Series.title: Prison Break
Series.note: A planned escape begins with deliberate imprisonment. Season one pays off careful preparation.

Series.title: Alice in Borderland
Series.note: Players decode lethal games in an empty Tokyo. Each rule set invites you to solve along.

Series.title: Sherlock
Series.note: Modern London becomes a sequence of deduction contests. Feature-length episodes give each puzzle room.

Series.title: Mr. Robot
Series.note: A hacker enters a conspiracy larger than his first target. Question what his perspective leaves out.

Series.title: Money Heist
Series.note: A mastermind directs a robbery from outside. Hostage dynamics continually disrupt the plan.

Series.title: Severance
Series.note: Workers cannot remember their lives outside the office. An immediate mystery with a measured reveal.

Series.title: Dark
Series.note: A disappearance connects families across generations. Best when you can track names closely.

Series.title: Bodyguard
Series.note: A protection officer must guard a politician he distrusts. The opening train encounter is the hook.

Series.title: Person of Interest
Series.note: A machine predicts people in danger. Early standalone cases gradually build a larger strategic conflict.
A counterterrorism agent races a real-time clock. Parallel crises make episodes easy to chain.

Series.title: The Night Of
Series.note: One night turns a student into a murder suspect. Procedural detail matters more than action.

Series.title: Line of Duty
Series.note: Investigators probe corruption inside the police. Interview-room reversals are the main attraction.

Series.title: Squid Game
Series.note: Debt-ridden contestants enter deadly children's games. Alliances turn simple rules into strategy.

Series.title: Luther
Series.note: A gifted detective takes dangerous personal risks. Some cases reveal the culprit and make pursuit the puzzle.

Series.title: Hannibal
Series.note: A profiler consults a psychiatrist with hidden motives. A psychological duel with graphic imagery.

Series.title: Breaking Bad
Series.note: A chemistry teacher builds a criminal enterprise. Each attempted solution creates a harder problem.

Series.title: The Boys
Series.note: An ordinary man joins a group investigating corporate superheroes. A brutal inversion of Avengers teamwork.

Series.title: Andor
Series.note: A thief is pulled into an emerging rebellion. Its patient opening earns a political payoff.

Series.title: Shōgun
Series.note: A foreign pilot enters a Japanese power struggle. Alliances and translation both become strategic weapons.

Series.title: Black Sails
Series.note: Pirates negotiate control of a vulnerable port. Political manoeuvring rewards patience past the opening episodes.

Series.title: The Last Kingdom
Series.note: A warrior raised between cultures chooses shifting allegiances. Strong fit for your Kingdom Come interest.

Series.title: Rome
Series.note: Soldiers and politicians navigate a collapsing republic. Personal decisions alter the political board.

Series.title: The Expanse
Series.note: A missing-person case pulls rival powers toward conflict. Dense setup leads to faction-level stakes.

Series.title: Silo
Series.note: An engineer probes the rules of an underground society. The world itself is the mystery.

Series.title: Slow Horses
Series.note: Disgraced spies stumble into operational trouble. Dry humour and practical tradecraft drive the reversals.

Series.title: The Capture
Series.note: Video evidence appears to contradict a suspect. The investigation keeps challenging what counts as proof.

Series.title: The Day of the Jackal
Series.note: An investigator tracks an elusive assassin. Preparation and countermeasures carry the chase.

Series.title: The Night Manager
Series.note: A hotel manager infiltrates an arms dealer's circle. Every new privilege increases exposure.

Series.title: Reacher
Series.note: A drifter investigates a killing in a hostile town. Combines deductions with decisive fights.

Series.title: Banshee
Series.note: An ex-con assumes a sheriff's identity. A fast hook and constant risk of exposure.

Series.title: Warrior
Series.note: A fighter arrives in a city divided by rival factions. Martial skill and street politics both count.

Series.title: Gangs of London
Series.note: A power vacuum destabilizes London crime families. Violent succession politics give it a Thrones edge.

Series.title: Peaky Blinders
Series.note: A gang leader expands his influence in Birmingham. Watch how business deals double as traps.

Series.title: Fargo
Series.note: A stranger disrupts a small-town investigation. Start with season one for tightly escalating consequences.

Series.title: True Detective
Series.note: Two detectives revisit a disturbing Louisiana case. Start with season one and expect a deliberate pace.

Series.title: Mindhunter
Series.note: Agents develop criminal profiling through interviews. Excellent for reading opponents, with limited closure.

Series.title: Broadchurch
Series.note: A coastal town investigates a child's death. Strong suspect puzzle with a heavy emotional focus.

Series.title: The Fall
Series.note: Detective and killer manoeuvre in parallel. Suspense comes from closing the distance.

Series.title: The Americans
Series.note: Undercover spies balance missions with family life. Patient tradecraft is the payoff.

Series.title: Homeland
Series.note: An analyst suspects a returning soldier. Season one plays suspicion against incomplete evidence.

Series.title: Counterpart
Series.note: A bureaucrat discovers a parallel side to his agency. Espionage becomes a puzzle about identity.

Series.title: Fringe
Series.note: An FBI team investigates impossible events. Standalone cases precede the larger mythology.

Series.title: Lost
Series.note: Survivors confront an island full of unexplained events. The pilot hooks fast, though answers take time.

Series.title: Travelers
Series.note: Agents inhabit people in the past to alter the future. Missions collide with their hosts' lives.

Series.title: 12 Monkeys
Series.note: A time traveller hunts the source of a plague. Long-range plotting rewards watching in order.

Series.title: Orphan Black
Series.note: A woman sees a stranger with her own face. The identity puzzle starts in episode one.

Series.title: Utopia
Series.note: Fans of a graphic novel stumble into a conspiracy. Choose the British original for its unsettling pursuit.

Series.title: Kingdom
Series.note: A Korean prince faces court intrigue during an outbreak. Palace strategy and survival reinforce each other.

Series.title: The Devil’s Plan
Series.note: Contestants build alliances in logic games. A reality competition for the part of you that likes watching plans work.

Series.title: The Queen’s Gambit
Series.note: A prodigy learns to read opponents over the chessboard. Character drama occupies as much time as competition.

Anime.title: Code Geass
Anime.note: A strategist gains the power to command obedience. Closest match to your mix of Death Note tactics and Attack on Titan rebellion.

Anime.title: The Promised Neverland
Anime.note: Children uncover a secret and plan under surveillance. Season one is the strongest fit.

Anime.title: Kaiji: Ultimate Survivor
Anime.note: A debtor faces games built around trust and betrayal. Every rule matters, though decisions can stretch over episodes.

Anime.title: Psycho-Pass
Anime.note: Police operate under a system that predicts criminal intent. Season one pits competing ideas of justice against each other.

Anime.title: Erased
Anime.note: A man returns to childhood with a crime to prevent. The premise and deadline arrive early.

Anime.title: Summer Time Rendering
Anime.note: A funeral draws a young man back to an island. Each discovery changes his survival strategy.

Anime.title: Parasyte: The Maxim
Anime.note: A teenager must cooperate with a parasite to survive. Fast escalation and competing loyalties suit your taste.

Anime.title: One Outs
Anime.note: A pitcher turns baseball into psychological warfare. Read each at-bat as a duel over incentives.

Anime.title: Terror in Resonance
Anime.note: Cryptic challenges draw a detective into pursuit. Short and built around a contest of deduction.

Anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
Anime.note: Two brothers pursue a cure and uncover a state conspiracy. Strong long-term payoff.

Anime.title: Hunter × Hunter
Anime.note: A boy enters a dangerous qualification exam. Later fights reward interpreting rules better than an opponent.

Anime.title: Fate/Zero
Anime.note: Rival teams compete in a secret war. Competing objectives make alliances unstable after a dense opener.

Anime.title: Steins;Gate
Anime.note: Experiments with messages to the past acquire consequences. Excellent payoff if you tolerate a slow opening stretch.

Anime.title: ID: INVADED
Anime.note: Detectives enter fragmented mental worlds to investigate killings. Each environment is a deduction puzzle.

Anime.title: Death Parade
Anime.note: Strangers play games under opaque conditions. Psychological pressure matters more than winning.

Anime.title: Moriarty the Patriot
Anime.note: A strategist uses crime against Britain's class system. The appeal is watching a plan take shape.

Anime.title: Talentless Nana
Anime.note: A class of gifted students faces an unseen threat. Start blind for the strongest first episode.

Anime.title: Tomodachi Game
Anime.note: Friends enter debt games designed to erode trust. Reading motives is as important as solving rules.

Anime.title: Classroom of the Elite
Anime.note: Students compete under hidden incentives. A reserved strategist turns school politics into calculated moves.

Anime.title: Battle Game in 5 Seconds
Anime.note: Captives must infer opponents' powers mid-fight. Winning depends on information asymmetry.

Anime.title: Ajin: Demi-Human
Anime.note: An immortal teenager becomes a target. A resourceful antagonist finds unsettling uses for the rules.

Anime.title: Inuyashiki
Anime.note: Two people receive the same extraordinary power. Their opposing choices set up an escalating collision.

Anime.title: 86 Eighty-Six
Anime.note: A commander learns who really fights her country's war. Military secrets and squad stakes echo AoT.

Anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam 00
Anime.note: An armed group intervenes in international conflicts. An independent Gundam story driven by political consequences.

Anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These
Anime.note: Two commanders face off across rival political systems. Fleet tactics and governance share the spotlight.

Anime.title: Vinland Saga
Anime.note: A young fighter follows the man he wants to defeat. Political schemes dominate early, then the pace turns reflective.

Anime.title: Kingdom
Anime.note: A servant aims to become a general in ancient China. Battlefield tactics reward patience with early animation.

Anime.title: Golden Kamuy
Anime.note: Rival factions pursue a coded treasure map. Sudden alliances make the search unpredictable.

Anime.title: Baccano!
Anime.note: Criminals and passengers collide across intersecting timelines. Reconstructing the order is half the fun.

Anime.title: Durarara!!
Anime.note: Ikebukuro's strangers are more connected than they seem. A patient ensemble mystery with overlapping schemes.

Anime.title: Odd Taxi
Anime.note: A taxi driver hears fragments of a missing-person case. Seemingly casual conversations become evidence.

Anime.title: Monster
Anime.note: A surgeon hunts a former patient. Exceptional criminal psychology with a much slower pace than Death Note.

Anime.title: Pluto
Anime.note: A detective investigates attacks on advanced robots. Dense casework and moral uncertainty outweigh the action.

Anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex
Anime.note: A cybercrime unit investigates identity and manipulation. Standalone missions surround a larger case.

Anime.title: Vivy: Fluorite Eye’s Song
Anime.note: An AI receives a mission that spans decades. Each intervention changes what comes next.

Anime.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
Anime.note: A young mercenary joins a crew in Night City. Short, decisive and built around the cost of upgrading.

Anime.title: Akudama Drive
Anime.note: An ordinary woman gets caught in a criminal mission. A heist structure gives the action direction.

Anime.title: Darker than Black
Anime.note: An operative navigates rival intelligence agencies. Missions hinge on powers with specific costs.

Anime.title: Black Lagoon
Anime.note: A businessman is pulled into a smuggling crew. Fast tactical action with morally flexible alliances.

Anime.title: Jormungand
Anime.note: A young guard travels with an arms dealer. Negotiations are often as dangerous as firefights.

Anime.title: Great Pretender
Anime.note: Con artists stage elaborate international jobs. The hook is figuring out who knows the full plan.

Anime.title: 91 Days
Anime.note: An infiltrator pursues revenge inside a crime family. A short Mafia-style story with a clear target.

Anime.title: Banana Fish
Anime.note: A gang leader investigates a mysterious phrase. Conspiracy drives the plot, alongside intense personal trauma.

Anime.title: Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers
Anime.note: Seven heroes gather for a prophecy naming six. Fantasy becomes a closed-circle impostor mystery.

Anime.title: Astra Lost in Space
Anime.note: Students stranded far from home coordinate survival. A compact mystery with a destination and payoff.

Anime.title: The Millionaire Detective – Balance: Unlimited
Anime.note: Two detectives tackle cases with radically different resources. Procedural puzzles build into a larger investigation.

Anime.title: Link Click
Anime.note: Two partners enter photographs to solve cases. This Chinese animated series fits your time-puzzle taste especially well.

Anime.title: World Trigger
Anime.note: Teams defend a city through coordinated tactical battles. Expect a long runway before the strongest strategy arcs.

Anime.title: Blue Lock
Anime.note: Strikers compete inside a harsh selection programme. Psychological rivalries give sports a survival-game edge.

Anime.title: Mob Psycho 100
Anime.note: A powerful psychic tries to govern his abilities. A strong completed arc, with more comedy than your leading picks.
